stem:
Mona lives far north of the Equator. Nitin lives near the Equator. Both note daytime length on 21 June.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Mona records her longest day of the year, while Nitin's day stays close to 12 hours.
Mona and Nitin both record about 12 hours, because day length is the same everywhere on that day.
Nitin records his longest day of the year, while Mona's day stays close to 12 hours.
Mona records her shortest day of the year, because June is winter in the Northern Hemisphere.

teacher.key_rationale: Around 21 June the Northern Hemisphere has its longest day; near the Equator day length stays near 12 hours. Day length is not the same everywhere. Swapping who has the long day reverses the pattern. June is not Northern winter.
